sloka: रामाभिषेकयुक्ताश्च कथाश्चक्रुर्मिथो जनाः ।रामाभिषेके संप्रप्ते चत्वरेषु गृहेषु च ॥२-६-१५॥
transliteration: rāmābhiṣekayuktāśca kathāścakrurmitho janāḥ ।rāmābhiṣeke saṁprapte catvareṣu gṛheṣu ca ॥2-6-15॥

translations.english: As the time for Rama's coronation was approaching, men in public squares and in private houses talked with one another about the consecration of Rama.
